cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Net price after grants, earlier years.** Average net price for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates who got grant aid or federal aid. Public institutions cover in-state or in-district payers only.
- **Financial aid cohort share.** A separate later table gives full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates as a percent of all undergraduates in the financial aid cohort.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Cost of attendance and net price.** Total cost of attendance and average net price for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded grant or federal aid. Public institutions cover in-state or in-district payers.
- **Aid details and tuition-rate counts.** Financial aid inputs behind net price for full-time, first-time undergraduates, including counts and percentages of the fall cohort paying in-district or in-state tuition.
- **Published charges and housing.** Application fees, tuition and required fees, and food and housing charges for undergraduate and graduate students, plus whether tuition varies by residency.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Charges for vocational programs.** Price of attendance by program for institutions reporting by program length, including the largest program and up to five more.
- **Offerings and services context.** Program offerings, control, affiliation and special learning opportunities, including veterans' support services. This describes institutions rather than what families pay.

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Public institution finances.** Revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities for public institutions using GASB accounting. It gives context on costs of providing education.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some source series remain separate because their definitions or structures differ. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details.

**Survey: Human Resources**

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Institution finance indicators.** Derived finance measures include revenue sources and expense categories. They include salaries, wages and benefits as a share of expenses, not teacher pay itself.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2015-16 through Academic year 2024-25.

- **Teacher certification program offerings.** Institution-level information on offerings, including whether a school is state-approved for teacher certification. It does not describe pay.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Graduation Rates**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Completion and transfer-out counts.** Counts for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking cohorts at 4-year and 2-year institutions: completers within 150% of normal time and transfer-outs, by gender and race/ethnicity where reported.
- **Derived graduation and transfer-out rates.** Ready-made rates for the total cohort and race/ethnicity groups, plus transfer-out rates, based on completion within 150% of normal time.
- **Less-than-2-year institution outcomes.** Separate cohort counts for less-than-2-year institutions: completers, transfer-outs, exclusions and students still enrolled after 150% of normal time.
- **Gender unknown in revised cohorts.** Cohort counts of students whose gender is unknown or another gender, for 4-year and less-than-4-year institutions. This table has no completion information.

**Survey: Fall Enrollment**

Reporting periods: Fall 2015 through Fall 2024.

- **Entering class and first-year retention.** Entering undergraduate counts and first-year retention for students who returned the next fall, where reported. Retention is only one view of leaving; student-to-faculty ratio is also included.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2015-16 through Academic year 2024-25.

- **Institution directory details.** Names, locations and characteristics such as control and level, useful for identifying and grouping institutions in the other tables.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Entering cohorts and outcome dates are different; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details. **Survey: Fall Enrollment**

- **Fall enrollment by nonresident status.** Fall counts of U.S. nonresident men and women, with breakdowns by level of student and full- or part-time status where reported.

- **Derived fall measures, including foreign first-time share.** Ready-made fall measures, including the percent of first-time students who are in-state, out-of-state, or from foreign countries.
- **State of residence of first-time freshmen.** First-time freshman counts by state of residence. Reporting is optional in odd-numbered years, and it does not clearly cover overseas students.

- **Derived twelve-month enrollment measures.** Derived twelve-month headcounts and full-time equivalent enrollment. These are overall measures, not described as nonresident-specific.

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Aid for first-time and all undergraduates.** Aid counts and amounts for full-time, first-time degree-seeking and all undergraduates. No overseas-student breakdown is described.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Charges and costs, newest year.** Explore application fees, tuition and required fees, food and housing for undergraduate and graduate students, plus cost of attendance estimates for first-time, full-time undergraduates.
- **Total cost of attendance summaries.** Explore derived total cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates, by residency and housing plan, for institutions that charge by academic year.

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Net price after grant aid.** Explore average net price for full-time, first-time undergraduates who receive grant aid or federal student aid, with the aid data used to calculate it.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Academic-year tuition and fees charged.** Explore average tuition and required fees for full-time undergraduate and graduate students, per-credit charges for part-time students, and selected professional programs.
- **Programs offered and institution profile.** Explore program and award level offerings, control, affiliation and special learning opportunities. This is context, not tuition amounts.
- **Branch campus costs.** Explore branch campus locations listed on College Navigator, with cost of attendance data for branches that enroll full-time, first-time undergraduates. It is not a complete list.
- **Derived cost of attendance summaries.** Explore derived total cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates, by residency and housing plan, for academic-year charging institutions.
- **Institution directory and web links.** Find institution names, addresses and web links, including admissions, financial aid and net price calculator pages, to look up an institution.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details. Your wording can have more than one meaning; these data areas are not treated as equivalent.

Tell me the institution, measure and years you would like to explore.
